**How-To: A Video Library of Must-See Videos** — learn key principles of External Ventricular Drain (EVD) management through SNACC educational resources.

## Videos

```{ojs}
videos = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  // Live listener — updates automatically whenever Videos
  // changes in Firestore, no page reload needed.
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "Videos"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function youtubeId(url) {
  if (!url) return null;
  const patterns = [
    /youtu\.be\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /youtube\.com\/embed\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/
  ];
  for (const p of patterns) {
    const m = url.match(p);
    if (m) return m[1];
  }
  return null;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Deterministic color per category name — same category always
// gets the same color, no manual mapping to maintain.
function categoryColor(name) {
  const palette = ["#007AFF", "#34C759", "#FF9500", "#AF52DE", "#FF3B30", "#30B0C7", "#FF2D55", "#8E8E93"];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  return palette[Math.abs(hash) % palette.length];
}
```

```{ojs}
videoCategories = ["All", ...new Set(videos.map(v => v.category).filter(Boolean))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
viewof videoCategoryFilter = {
  const container = html`<div class="fs-filters"></div>`;
  container.value = "All";

  function draw() {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    videoCategories.forEach(cat => {
      const isActive = cat === container.value;
      const color = cat === "All" ? "#2c7be5" : categoryColor(cat);
      const pill = html`<button type="button" class="fs-filter-pill${isActive ? " active" : ""}">${cat}</button>`;
      if (isActive) {
        pill.style.background = color;
        pill.style.borderColor = color;
      }
      pill.onclick = () => {
        container.value = cat;
        container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
        draw();
      };
      container.appendChild(pill);
    });
  }
  draw();
  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
filteredVideos = videoCategoryFilter === "All"
  ? videos
  : videos.filter(v => v.category === videoCategoryFilter)
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="fs-grid">
  ${filteredVideos.length === 0
    ? `<div class="fs-empty">No videos found in this category yet.</div>`
    : filteredVideos.map(v => {
        const id = youtubeId(v.url);
        const embed = id
          ? `<iframe class="fs-card-image" style="height:200px;border:none;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${id}" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>`
          : "";
        return `
          <div class="fs-card">
            ${embed}
            <div class="fs-card-body">
              <h4 class="fs-card-title">${v.title ?? "Untitled"}</h4>
              <p class="fs-card-desc">${v.subtitle ?? ""}</p>
              ${v.category ? `<span class="fs-badge" style="background:${categoryColor(v.category)};">${v.category}</span>` : ""}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join("")}
</div>`
```

## Learning Objectives

- Understand how EVD systems function
- Recognize proper leveling and setup
- Interpret intracranial pressure (ICP) values
- Identify common pitfalls and safety risks
- Apply concepts to clinical practice

**Clinical Tip:** Pause each video and reflect on how each concept applies to your own clinical environment.
